statements.status_notes: Some versions of PingFederate ship with a vulnerable jackson-core, but the bug only exists on Jackson's non-blocking/async parser path, and an exhaustive search (source, compiled bytecode, and a full-jar dependency scan) found no caller of that API anywhere in PingFederate's own code or its dependency graph. No functional risk today.

PingAccess ships jackson-core 2.17.0 (within affected range <2.18.8). The async parser (AsyncInputFeeder/NonBlockingJsonParser) is an explicit opt-in API. Zero references to any async parser entry point found across all PingAccess JARs. Not exploitable.
